description: Search Unsplash photos by keyword, topic, collection, photographer, photo URL, or any supported Unsplash URL.

collectionIds.description: Collection IDs or collection URLs, e.g. `1065396` or `https://unsplash.com/collections/1065396/...`.
collectionIds.title: Collections (mode=byCollection)

color.description: Filter keyword searches by Unsplash's dominant-colour tag. Not supported on topic, collection, or portfolio feeds.
color.title: Dominant colour (mode=search)

freeOnly.description: Exclude Unsplash+ (paid/locked) photos. Their full-size files require a separate Unsplash+ plan.
freeOnly.title: Free photos only

includePhotoDetails.description: Add tags, camera EXIF, geolocation, topics, and view/download counts. Costs extra requests per photo and is slower.
includePhotoDetails.title: Include photo details

includePhotographerStats.description: Add each photographer's lifetime view and download totals. One extra request per photographer.
includePhotographerStats.title: Include photographer totals

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted photos across all queries and URLs.
maxItems.title: Max photos

mode.description: What to scrape. Each mode has its own list field below.
enumTitles: Find photos related to a photo
mode.title: Mode

orientation.description: Only keep photos of this orientation. The filter is exact and works in every mode.
orientation.title: Orientation

photoIds.description: Unsplash photo IDs, slugs, or photo page URLs, e.g. `fWBZ9r4vO9M`. Used as lookup targets in byPhoto and as seed photos in byRelated.
photoIds.title: Photo IDs or URLs (mode=byPhoto or byRelated)

searchOrderBy.description: Sort keyword search results by best match or newest first.
searchOrderBy.title: Search order (mode=search)

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords, e.g. `nature`, `coffee shop`, `minimal workspace`. Each query is searched separately.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

startUrls.description: Any mix of supported Unsplash search, topic, collection, photographer, or photo URLs.
startUrls.title: Unsplash URLs (mode=byUrls)

topicSlugs.description: One or more curated Unsplash photo topics.
topicSlugs.title: Topics (mode=byTopic)

userOrderBy.description: Sort a photographer's photos. Pinned matches the order shown on their Unsplash profile.
userOrderBy.title: Portfolio order (mode=byUser)

usernames.description: Photographer usernames with or without `@`, or profile URLs, e.g. `v2osk` or `https://unsplash.com/@v2osk`.
usernames.title: Photographers (mode=byUser)

title: Unsplash Photo Scraper Input
